segments.sn35.77:1.1: “Yaṃ kho, rādha, dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.77:1.3: Cakkhu kho, rādha, dukkhaṃ. Tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.77:1.7: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassa … pe … adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ. Tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe …
segments.sn35.77:1.12: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ. Tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.77:1.13: Yaṃ kho, rādha, dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo”ti.

lines: Navopi hi koci paññāto hoti rāhulatthero viya sumanasāmaṇero viya ca, ayaṃ pana navo ceva apaññāto ca.
74-78. Appaññātoti nāmagottato ceva sīlādiguṇehi ca appaññāto avissuto.
